definitions.first50: updates 0-49 = micro-batches 0-399 (80 draws per task); update 0 runs at the initial parameters
definitions.weighting: tasks equally weighted (the sampler draws task m mod 5), windows uniform within a task
definitions.units: stage CE in nats; location smooth-L1 and action/future-latent losses as logged (unitless)
definitions.references: fitted on the training panel; *_same_draws = mean of the reference loss on exactly the draws the head is compared with (the location loss varies strongly between windows)
definitions.se: sd/sqrt(n) over draws, treating draws as independent; ci95 = mean +/- 1.96 se
definitions.paired: per-draw differences on identical windows; across arms also identical flow-matching time and noise
definitions.first_visit: a late draw whose window had not been drawn at any earlier micro-batch of the run

novelty.note: novel = the window had not been drawn at any earlier micro-batch; all nine runs share this schedule

references_panel.note: panel-wide, task-equal weights. task_prior = H(stage | task) = CE of the best predictor that knows only the task; task_plus_elapsed_time_* are leave-one-demonstration-out (extra reference)
panel-wide, task-equal weights; mean centres weighted by 1/(n_task * visible cameras), the exact loss minimiser; plain_mean_variant weights every visible camera-window equally (within task)

rms_centre_error_px_equivalent.note: 256 * sqrt(2 * mean loss); approximate RMS error of the predicted box centre in pixels

awomo_i_location_minus_global_centre_lat.text_claim: stays close to a single global constant
